### 5. Acceptance Criteria
<!-- What specific conditions must be met for this feature to be complete? -->
- [ ] Feature implemented using vanilla JavaScript (no extra external frameworks).
- [ ] Keyboard navigation and accessibility criteria maintained.
- [ ] UI state and LocalStorage synchronization verified.
- [ ] Responsive behavior tested on mobile and desktop viewports.
